get.summary: Read an exact Dashboard Draft query run
get.description: Requires current Explorer or higher Workspace membership and an existing Draft. Reading never starts or recreates a Draft.

Read-only composition of owner resources; no new execution or durable activity ledger. Stable descending time/kind/id keyset. Cursors are encrypted, bound to the requesting principal and query scope, and valid only for the issuing Control process lifetime. After a 400 invalid cursor, refresh from the first page. Explorer or higher can read all Workspace Explore history and Draft Dashboard runs. Viewer receives 403; missing Workspace or direct membership remains 404. A failed source is reported and pagination pauses until retry. Credential surface is factual and may be unknown for older rows. Semantic Model and Metric items read append-only definition change records: id is the changeId, state is CREATED, UPDATED, or DELETED, and deleted definitions link to their original-ID History. Dashboard Viewer Session runs are grouped into one DASHBOARD_SESSION row per Session whose state is the worst of its queries' latest runs; shared Draft runs stay one DASHBOARD_RUN row per run. Explore titles follow the Explore run-title rules: metric and grouping labels for a Semantic run, or the first FROM table and a short SQL prefix for a SQL run. Full SQL, warehouse messages, and result cells are never returned.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Live runs or latest resource changes and terminal runs.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset scan cursor, bound to workspace, section, actor, surface and agent app filters. Empty pages may have a next cursor after authorization filtering.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: all (default), me, or a responsible user UUID.

parameters.name: surface
parameters.description: Keeps only work recorded through the Web or through an agent connection. Omitted keeps both. Combines with actor and binds the cursor.

parameters.name: agentClient
parameters.description: Keeps only agent work recorded with this agent app's client id, as listed by the agent-apps read. Requires surface=AGENT and binds the cursor.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum scanned candidates per page; only readable candidates are returned.

parameters.name: watch
parameters.description: Live only: up to 100 comma-separated KIND:UUID pairs previously observed. Returns current readable state, including terminal state. Missing items are removed unless their source is unavailable.

200.description: Readable owner activity and watched run states.

delete.summary: Delete a Connector, destroy its credentials, and remove its current Catalog state
delete.description: Owner only. The Connector leaves lists, reads, and the plan limit, and its name can be reused. Credential versions are destroyed, and the Connector's current Catalog objects, selections, and search entries are removed. Catalog refresh history and Explore run history are kept. Semantic definitions are unchanged and fail at query time until they use another connector. Deletion cannot be undone. A running Catalog refresh or table list refresh returns 409 CONNECTOR_REFRESH_ACTIVE; cancel it, then delete. Repeating the request after success returns 404.

post.description: Starts Catalog ingestion for the requested connector or Catalog entry. If an ingestion job for the same workspace and entry is already RUNNING or CANCEL_REQUESTED, the server returns that active job. After the existing job reaches a terminal state, the next request creates a fresh job. A lost response followed by a request after the job is terminal may therefore create another ingestion; use the returned job resource for observation and cancellation.

get.description: Reads the RUNNING or CANCEL_REQUESTED ingestion job for the connector entry, or for the Catalog entry named by catalogName. An existing entry without such a job answers 204 No Content. The response is 404 when the connector is missing or outside the workspace, or when the entry does not exist for that connector: catalogName on a connector without Catalogs, no catalogName on a connector with Catalogs, or a Catalog that is not selected.

204.description: The entry exists and has no RUNNING or CANCEL_REQUESTED ingestion job.

get.description: Explorer or higher. Returns selection counts, current table count, and refresh status per connector in one request.

delete.summary: Delete a Dashboard and its linked Pages
delete.description: Explorer or higher. Cancels active runs and hard deletes current definition, Draft, Sessions, QueryRuns and schedule state with linked Dashboard Pages, search projection and a DELETED history record in one transaction. Results are cleaned by the existing cleanup loop. Missing, repeated and other-Workspace requests return 404. No body or idempotency key. A cancellation race returns retryable 503.

204.description: Dashboard deleted; its definition history remains readable.

post.description: Native SQL rejection returns 409 RAW_SQL_VALIDATION_REJECTED with the Execution safe message. Warehouse permission denial returns 409 PERMISSION_DENIED and a warehouse-account permission hint; a read-only transaction violation returns 409 READ_ONLY_VIOLATION with the safe message. These deterministic rejections have retryable=false. Before acceptance, Execution validation failure codes (including CONNECTION_FAILED, CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED and RAW_SQL_VALIDATION_FAILED) are preserved as Problem codes with 503 and retryable=true. RAW_SQL_VALIDATION_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED means validation timed out without identifying the cause. Warehouse authentication failure preserves AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with 503, retryable=false and a prompt to update Connector credentials. Monomer Execution RPC unavailability returns SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE with 503 and retryable=true.

post.description: Lists installed Agent Workspace collections allowed by the current cumulative Workspace role, ordered by path with a cursor. Viewer discovery exposes Pages only; Explorer exposes internal collections; Owner additionally exposes management collections. Uninstalled owners are not advertised. Unfetched Catalog options return 409 CATALOG_SELECTION_OPTIONS_NOT_FETCHED with retryable=false and advertise refresh only to an admitted Explorer or higher. LIST never starts refresh, ingestion, or warehouse I/O.

Searches supported Workspace resources, one result list per query. path, queries, and limitPerQuery are required, and results return in input order. Supported kinds are CONNECTOR, CATALOG, SCHEMA, RELATION, SEMANTIC_MODEL, METRIC, DASHBOARD, and PAGE. PAGE searches current display titles by case-insensitive substring matching of every whitespace-separated query word; Page descriptions and Document content are not searched. workspace/pages searches Pages only; workspace with kinds [PAGE] is also Page-only. These requests allow Viewer or higher with current direct membership: Viewer sees only currently placed Pages and reader metadata as in Web, while Explorer or higher sees the authoring inventory including unplaced Pages. Deleted Pages are excluded. Other searches require Explorer or higher and search resource names and descriptions. Omitting kinds searches every supported kind in scope. Mixed results keep ranked metadata hits before Page hits under one limitPerQuery. There is no cursor.

Reads one exact Agent Workspace resource. availableOperations lists every follow-up operation that applies to the current caller and state; it is not final authorization or a guarantee of success. The workspace root's resources offer the same collection LIST. A current Dashboard includes Draft READ when the caller can edit and a Draft exists. A Draft or Session advertises refresh only when it has queries, and a Session advertises EDIT only when it has Variables. An empty Catalog Selection still offers the ingestion history LIST.
Creates a declared child resource from its collection input. Duplicate canonical names are conflicts; the Agent channel scope does not replace the user's cumulative Workspace role.

A closed request, selected by path, for a Semantic Model, Metric, Dashboard Draft, Dashboard Session, Connector Catalog Selection, or Catalog Selection. Applies 1 to 100 operations in order, atomically, to the owner's editable document (not the read envelope), and the owner validates the final document. Semantic Models, Metrics, and Selections are last-write-wins and reject revision, including null; Drafts and Sessions require a string revision for compare-and-set. A Selection accepts exactly one root replace with a complete document, and a Session accepts only replace of existing Variable names. A root replace for a Semantic definition or Draft needs a complete owner document, and intermediate documents during a partial patch may be incomplete. Identity and server state can't be edited; the owner checks the name match, existing keys, declared types, and revision at run time. Saving a Semantic definition with unresolved references doesn't guarantee that it can run.

Passes a declared owner action to the current owner use case. Dashboard Draft start returns an existing Draft unchanged without applying the input parameterBindings, and creates a Draft from the bindings only when none exists; use edit to change an existing Draft's inputs. Every call revalidates input, permission, and state.

Problem400.description: Closed schema, path, or cursor Problem Details

Problem401.description: Missing or invalid credential Problem Details

Problem403.description: An admitted member lacks the required role: ROLE_REQUIRED Problem Details. Missing membership or target returns 404; invalid or expired credentials return 401.

Problem404.description: Unknown, internal, or other-workspace identifier Problem Details with indistinguishable shape

Problem409.description: Revision, idempotency, cursor, cancellation, or result-readiness conflict Problem Details. Dashboard concurrency codes SESSION_CONFLICT, QUERY_RUN_CONFLICT, DRAFT_CONFLICT, EXECUTION_ADMISSION_CONFLICT and QUERY_RUN_CANCEL_CONFLICT are retryable.

Problem422.description: Human REST input values violate owner validation. Agent input validation uses 400 because its status enum has no 422. Concurrency conflicts use 409 and retryable execution backpressure uses 503.

Problem500.description: Unexpected internal owner execution argument error. INTERNAL_ERROR is logged, sanitized, and not retryable; read the target before resending creates or starts.

Problem503.description: Owner or infrastructure Problem Details. EXECUTION_BACKPRESSURED is retryable. Retry-After is present if and only if retryable is true. Unconfirmed non-idempotent Agent changes use OWNER_UNAVAILABLE with retryable=false and require reading the target before resending.

Retry-After.description: Present if and only if the Problem Details body has retryable=true. Absent for retryable=false, including AUTHENTICATION_FAILED and unconfirmed non-idempotent Agent changes.
